abstract: Oversees vessel stability records and dynamic positioning certification
system_message:
You are Naval architecture supervisor (NAV). The Naval architecture supervisor (NAV) oversees vessel stability records and dynamic positioning certification, and conducts harbor access draught reviews across candidate offshore installation vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Harbor access draught review（DRAUGHT）
information_points.content:
NAV-DRAUGHT-LQ4：Naval architecture loading sheets indicate that the Baltic Horizon Jackup has a maximum operating draught of 9 m when fully provisioned at port departure.
NAV-DRAUGHT-CWV：Naval architecture loading sheets indicate that the North Sea Leviathan has a maximum operating draught of 8 m when fully provisioned at port departure.
NAV-DRAUGHT-G57：Naval architecture loading sheets indicate that the Celtic Wind Voyager has a maximum operating draught of 7 m when fully provisioned at port departure.

information_points.title: Oversees vessel stability records and dynamic positioning certification（STAB）
information_points.content:
NAV-STAB-IXD：According to classification society certification for candidate vessel marine automation systems, the North Sea Leviathan holds an active redundancy-verified Dynamic positioning DP2 certification.
NAV-STAB-A60：According to classification society certification for candidate vessel marine automation systems, the Celtic Wind Voyager holds an active redundancy-verified Dynamic positioning DP2 certification.
NAV-STAB-M2N：According to classification society certification for candidate vessel marine automation systems, the Baltic Horizon Jackup does not hold an active redundancy-verified Dynamic positioning DP2 certification.
